newsitem.title: USA: Intelligent Controls sees Q2 EPS of $0.03.
newsitem.headline: Intelligent Controls sees Q2 EPS of $0.03.

text.p: Intelligent Controls Inc said Wednesday that its second quarter net income will reach about $0.03 per share compared to a loss of $0.03 per share in the second quarter of 1996.
Revenues for the period are expected to climb to about $3.1 million, about a 35 percent increase from the $2.3 million in the second quarter of 1997, it said.

"The improved earnings and continued sales growth are the result of better market conditions in the petroleum market, the success of our cost cutting program and enhanced product quality," Chief Executive Alan Lukas said in a statement.
The company said it expects to release final results for the second quarter in the next 10 days.
